notes: The proof avoids the documented containment error but adds the unprovided neighborhood hypothesis (N). Containing the diagonal does not imply (N). Take X={0}∪{1/k:k≥1} with its usual subspace topology, well-ordered as 0≺1≺1/2≺⋯, and V_m=Δ_X for every m. All stated relation hypotheses hold, but A_n(x)={x}, and the singleton family is not discrete at 0. The final neighborhood argument therefore proves only a strengthened, conditional statement.
